name: Ledger OG social card — fanned hardware wallets on dark gradient by ledger.com
description: A 1200×630 social card built on a near-black radial gradient that lightens toward the upper left, giving the product photography a studio backdrop. The [ LEDGER ] wordmark sits alone in the top ~15%, its corner-bracket motif doubling as a frame device, while three hardware wallets fan across the lower two-thirds at slightly different rotations, bleeding off the bottom edge for scale. Each device screen carries real, legible UI (a Bitcoin signing prompt, a send/receive summary, an app grid) so the card communicates function, not just hardware, with a single orange accent on the centre device acting as the only saturated colour and focal anchor.
